verdict.rationale: USPTO runs an API at api.uspto.gov that rejects unauthenticated requests with an auth challenge, which implies some credential model. Nothing in the pack shows that a user can issue scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific API credentials. The sponsored-support-staff delegation for AIR forms is a human, UI-level role arrangement, which is an adjacent feature rather than scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
